name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Power Capacitor EPC-5
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Power Capacitor EPC-5
description: A compact supercapacitor that stores a massive electrical charge and can discharge it in a single burst or as sustained power over several hours. The EPC-5 is the size of a canteen and stores enough energy to power a cyberdeck for 48 hours, jump-start a vehicle, or deliver a single 50kW pulse for weapons applications. The capacitor charges from any power source in 15 minutes and can be recharged thousands of times without degradation. Its dual-mode capability — sustained low-power or instantaneous high-power discharge — makes it the most versatile portable power source in GLMZ.

specifications.info: 000+ charge cycles; vehicle interface; weapon power port; short-circuit protected

story_hooks: An EPC-5 was used to power an improvised electromagnetic pulse device — the 50 kW burst mode provided enough energy to disable every electronic device within 20 meters.

A chain of EPC-5 capacitors has been wired in series to create a power supply capable of running a plasma cutter for an hour — the setup was used to breach a vault door in a district with no power grid access.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A rugged cylindrical supercapacitor resembling a military-grade water canteen with pronounced ribbed cooling fins running vertically along its body. The form factor is deliberately blocky and industrial, designed for grip and durability rather than aesthetic refinement. Top-mounted interface cluster with three distinct connection ports.
physical_description.weight_description: 0.8 kg — handheld and pocketable with carrying strap attachment points; balanced enough for one-handed operation despite dense internal engineering
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy chassis with embedded carbon-composite reinforcement bands
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with anodized texture; cooling fins have a brushed finish with slight iridescence from thermal dissipation coatings
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with electric cyan accent striping along the seams and port surrounds; Zheng-Dao branding in burnt orange
physical_description.interface_elements: Top cluster features three illuminated ports: USB-C power output (blue-ringed), vehicle interface connector (orange magnetic latch), and weapon/high-draw pulse port (red safety-gated). Dual-mode toggle switch with haptic feedback. Hexagonal charge indicator readout (7-segment LED cascade) displaying percentage in dim cyan. Heat-dissipation vent grilles near the base.
distinctive_features: Prominent vertical cooling fins with gradient from matte to reflective surfaces
Tri-color port ring system indicating discharge mode capability
Rotating charge indicator dial with mechanical clicking feedback
Impact-resistant corner guards with grip texture
Subtle pulse-frequency blue underglow when at full capacity (passive charge state indicator)
Serialized safety certification stamp embossed into lower panel
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES embossed in simplified logographic characters across upper third; regulatory stamps for GLMZ tier-2+ compliance; batch code and manufacturing date laser-etched on base
physical_description.condition_typical: In active use, slight residual heat signature visible along cooling fins; charge indicator pulsing softly in cyan; minor scratching on the aluminum from field deployment is cosmetically normal and expected
